heroText: Blumenau is a German-influenced city in southern Brazil, known for timbered facades, breweries and Brazil's biggest Oktoberfest. Base near Vila Germanica Park for events, walk Rua XV de Novembro for the historic centre, and stop at Museu da Cerveja for beer culture. Navegantes airport is the main flight gateway, with road transfers linking the city to the Santa Catarina coast.

areas.name: Centro
areas.text: Centro is the most useful first base for Rua XV de Novembro, restaurants, shops and short taxi rides to Vila Germanica.

areas.name: Vila Germanica
areas.text: The Vila Germanica area is best during Oktoberfest or trade events, keeping the main pavilions and evening crowds close.

areas.name: Ponta Aguda
areas.text: Ponta Aguda sits across the river from Centro, quieter and residential, with easy access by car or rideshare.

areas.name: Victor Konder
areas.text: Victor Konder is practical for business trips and city services, close to the university side and central roads.

areas.name: Garcia
areas.text: Garcia works for visitors needing the southern side of Blumenau, with local hotels and routes toward parks and factories.
areas.bestFor: local visits, car trips, longer stays

stayOverview: Choose Centro for the easiest general Blumenau stay, or Vila Germanica when Oktoberfest, concerts or trade events drive the trip. Ponta Aguda is quieter, Victor Konder suits business errands, and Garcia is better for car-based local visits.
hotelIntro: Blumenau hotels split between central convenience and event access: Centro keeps restaurants and Rua XV de Novembro close, Vila Germanica is strongest for festival dates, while Ponta Aguda, Victor Konder and Garcia work better with a car.
rentalCars: A rental car helps for coastal trips, wineries and Navegantes transfers, but is not essential between Centro and Vila Germanica.

travelTips.title: Event dates
travelTips.text: Book well ahead for Oktoberfest, when Vila Germanica rooms and central hotels rise sharply and traffic changes around the pavilions.

travelTips.title: Airport transfers
travelTips.text: Confirm Navegantes transfers in advance, especially for late arrivals, because Blumenau is inland and not beside the airport.

travelTips.title: Best base
travelTips.text: Stay in Centro outside festival periods; it keeps historic streets, restaurants and taxi access to Vila Germanica simple.

travelTips.title: Coast add-on
travelTips.text: Add Balneario Camboriu or Itajai if the trip needs beach time after the city and festival stops.

highlights.title: Vila Germanica Park
highlights.text: Vila Germanica Park is Blumenau's festival complex, the main stage for Oktoberfest and many of the city's largest events.

highlights.title: Rua XV de Novembro
highlights.text: Rua XV de Novembro is the central historic street, useful for architecture, shopping and a first walk through Blumenau.

highlights.title: Museu da Cerveja
highlights.text: Museu da Cerveja is a named Blumenau landmark that helps structure a real visit, adding orientation, local context and a clear route anchor.

highlights.title: Catedral Sao Paulo Apostolo
highlights.text: Catedral Sao Paulo Apostolo is a modern landmark in the centre, easy to combine with Rua XV de Novembro.

highlights.title: Museu Hering
highlights.text: Museu Hering is a named Blumenau landmark that helps structure a real visit, adding orientation, local context and a clear route anchor.

highlights.title: Parque Ramiro Ruediger
highlights.text: Parque Ramiro Ruediger is a practical green space near Vila Germanica, good for a walk between event sessions.

nearbyIdeas.text: Pomerode is a nearby German-Brazilian town with half-timbered buildings, family attractions and an easy short drive from Blumenau.

nearbyIdeas.text: Balneario Camboriu adds beaches, high-rises and nightlife to a Blumenau trip, usually as a full-day coastal detour.

history.text: Despite the floods, clashes with wild animals and even with the indigenous peoples, due to the work of German immigrants willing to migrate continuously in greater numbers, the settlement prospered.
